title: Performance.Started
description: The payload of a performance's first event (topic troupe.core.runs.performance:Performance.Started): what was performed and its steps, recorded in the same batch as its first run's start, so neither is recorded without the other. Field names are as recorded.

lineage.description: Its lineage names the performance (spec: lineage, "Lineage names an event's performance").

originator_topic.description: The event-sourcing library's name for the aggregate the stream holds.

performance_id.description: The performance's id, which is also its stream's.

performed.description: What was performed. Until flows, always an actor, by its name then.

kind.description: What kind of thing was performed.

name.description: Its name in config when it was performed.

steps.description: The performance's steps, in the order they run. Until flows, exactly one.

direction.description: The direction the performance was given, as a reference to the artifact holding it.

config.description: The config version the performance started with: the ids of the config stream's heads, sorted.

actor.description: The step's actor, by its name then.

approvers.description: The step's approvers and where they came from, as its run records them. Absent: the step's actor works in the theatre, so its run has no gate.
